data.title: Chat UI
data.tagline: A chat UI is the interactive interface that organizes a message list, input area, and conversation feedback states.
data.learningOutcome: You can check whether a chat task shows send, pending, reply, and failure, and separate interface problems from model-answer quality.
data.description: After someone sends a question, the interface should add their message to the list, show waiting or streamed output, and provide an understandable error and retry path on failure. Customer support chat and AI chat both need these interface capabilities. It is the shell people see and use, not the model or support system behind it.

learning.assumes: You have used customer-support chat, team messaging, or an AI conversation product.
learning.outcome: You can check whether a chat task shows send, pending, reply, and failure, and separate interface problems from model-answer quality.

explanation.title: The message list keeps context
explanation.text: Messages from each role need clear order and distinction. A long conversation must remain scrollable and readable, and new messages should not interrupt someone reading earlier content.

explanation.title: Input and feedback cannot disappear
explanation.text: After send, people need to know work is in progress. Network failures, unsendable content, and interrupted replies require a specific state and a useful next action.

data.boundary: A chat UI is not a language model, a support person, or a messaging protocol. A smooth interface cannot prove an answer is correct; a correct model answer cannot replace sending state, error feedback, and keyboard usability.

lessonPractice.title: A user sends a message and the network disconnects. What chat-interface feedback fits best?

options.label: Keep the unsent message, clearly show sending failed, and offer retry or edit-and-send-again
options.feedback: Correct. The person knows what happened, does not lose the text, and has a usable next step.

options.label: Delete the message so the chat list looks cleaner
options.feedback: The person cannot know whether it was delivered and may lose text that is hard to recreate.

options.label: Show a successful reply first and handle it when the network returns
options.feedback: That fabricates state; interface wording cannot replace an actual delivery result.

data.agentPrompt: Complete this Chat UI: distinguish both sides in the message list, show pending after sending from the input area, and keep the original message with retry on failure. Do not alter the model prompt or response content. Test successful send, pending, and offline failure states afterward.
